curriculum.subject: LANGUAGE_ARTS
curriculum.description: Students practice reading words that begin or end with consonant digraphs by blending sounds together to form recognizable words. Focus: Decoding words featuring the sh, ch, th, wh, and ph consonant digraphs. Examples: ship, chop, thin, whip, phone, dash, rich, path, moth, graph. Constraints: Isolate the digraph sound at the start of words first, then advance to final position usage in the phonics-blender.

status: authored; catalog-checked; each binding generator-probed once; not hydrated as a lesson; not runtime-tested
learnerAction: Blend words with sh, ch, th, wh, ph at the start, then at the end.
